example.hanzi: 我幾乎每天都搭捷運上班。
example.pinyin: Wǒ jīhū měi tiān dōu dā jiéyùn shàngbān.
example.gloss: I take the MRT to work almost every day.

example.hanzi: 他上課很認真，答得也很好。
example.pinyin: Tā shàngkè hěn rènzhēn, dá de yě hěn hǎo.
example.gloss: He's very serious in class, and answers well too.

vocab.gloss: foot; leg (of an animal or an object); base (of an object)

example.pinyin: Wǒ de jiǎo hěn tòng, jīntiān bù néng pǎobù.
example.gloss: My foot hurts a lot; I can't run today.

example.hanzi: 這家店主要賣便當和飲料。
example.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn zhǔyào mài biàndāng hàn yǐnliào.
example.gloss: This shop mainly sells lunchboxes and drinks.

vocab.gloss: to meet; to run into; to come across

example.hanzi: 我昨天在路上遇到同學。
example.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān zài lù shàng yùdào tóngxué.
example.gloss: I ran into a classmate on the street yesterday.

example.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎobǎn hěn niánqīng ō.

grammar.title: 幾乎 — almost / nearly
grammar.pattern: Subject + 幾乎 + (都／沒) + Verb / Adjective
grammar.explanation: 幾乎 goes before the verb or adjective to say something is almost or nearly the case. It is often used with 都 (all) for 'almost all / almost every', and with 沒(有) for 'almost none / hardly'.

examples.hanzi: 我幾乎每天都騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīhū měi tiān dōu qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.gloss: I ride a bike almost every day.

examples.hanzi: 他太忙了，幾乎沒有時間休息。
examples.pinyin: Tā tài máng le, jīhū méiyǒu shíjiān xiūxí.
examples.gloss: He's so busy he has almost no time to rest.

examples.hanzi: 這裡的東西幾乎都很貴。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de dōngxi jīhū dōu hěn guì.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme le? Jiǎo bù shūfú ma?
dialogue.gloss: What's wrong? Is your foot bothering you?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 對啊，我昨天跑步跑太多，現在腳很痛。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì a, wǒ zuótiān pǎobù pǎo tài duō, xiànzài jiǎo hěn tòng.
dialogue.gloss: Yeah, I ran too much yesterday, and now my foot hurts.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 你要不要去醫院檢查一下？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ yào bú yào qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá yíxià?
dialogue.gloss: Do you want to go to the hospital for a check-up?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 不用啦，休息一下就好。對了，我昨天在捷運站遇到你哥哥。
dialogue.pinyin: Búyòng la, xiūxí yíxià jiù hǎo. Duì le, wǒ zuótiān zài jiéyùn zhàn yùdào nǐ gēge.
dialogue.gloss: No need, I'll just rest. Oh right, I ran into your brother at the MRT station yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 真的嗎？他現在在哪裡上班？
dialogue.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Tā xiànzài zài nǎlǐ shàngbān?
dialogue.gloss: Really? Where does he work now?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 他在一家新開的店上班，老闆很年輕，做事也很認真。
dialogue.pinyin: Tā zài yì jiā xīn kāi de diàn shàngbān, lǎobǎn hěn niánqīng, zuòshì yě hěn rènzhēn.
dialogue.gloss: He works at a newly opened shop; the boss is young and very conscientious.

sentences.gloss: He is very earnest in class.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīhū měi tiān dōu zǒulù huí jiā.
sentences.gloss: I walk home almost every day.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān zài chēzhàn yùdào tā.
sentences.gloss: I ran into him at the station yesterday.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de kèrén zhǔyào shì niánqīngrén.
sentences.gloss: This shop's customers are mainly young people.

example.pinyin: Wǒmen hěn jiǔ méi jiàn le.
example.gloss: We haven't seen each other for a long time.

vocab.gloss: to draw; to paint; picture; painting; to draw (a line) (variant of 划)

example.gloss: My little sister loves to draw.

example.pinyin: Wǎnshàng de biǎoyǎn bā diǎn kāishǐ.

vocab.gloss: mountain pass; to close; to shut; to turn off; to confine; to lock (sb) up; to shut (sb in a room, a bird in a cage etc)

example.pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ guān mén, hǎo ma?
example.gloss: Please close the door for me, okay?

example.pinyin: Gāngcái lǎobǎn dǎ diànhuà gěi nǐ.
example.gloss: The boss called you just now.

example.hanzi: 我哥哥的辦公室在三樓。
example.pinyin: Wǒ gēge de bàngōngshì zài sān lóu.
example.gloss: My older brother's office is on the third floor.

grammar.title: 動詞 + 了 + 很久（做某事做了很長時間）
grammar.pattern: 主語 + 動詞 + 了 + 很久
grammar.explanation: 要說一件事做了很長的時間，可以用「動詞 + 了 + 很久」。「久」表示時間長。常用的還有「好久不見」，是朋友很長時間沒見面時說的話。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài ménkǒu zhàn le hěn jiǔ.
examples.gloss: I stood at the door for a long time.

examples.pinyin: Tā huà le hěn jiǔ, huà de hěn hǎo.
examples.gloss: He drew for a long time, and he draws well.

examples.hanzi: 剛才我跑了很久，現在很累。
examples.pinyin: Gāngcái wǒ pǎo le hěn jiǔ, xiànzài hěn lèi.
examples.gloss: I ran for a long time just now; now I'm tired.

grammar.title: 剛才（表示過去很短的時間）
grammar.pattern: 剛才 + 主語 + 動詞 / 主語 + 剛才 + 動詞
grammar.explanation: 「剛才」表示說話前不久的時間，放在主語前面或後面都可以，句子說的是已經發生的事。

examples.gloss: He was in the office just now.
I turned off the TV just now.
The performance just now was really great.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.pinyin: Xiǎo Ān, hǎo jiǔ bú jiàn!
dialogue.gloss: Xiao An, long time no see!

dialogue.speaker: 小安
dialogue.hanzi: 是啊，你剛才在哪裡？我打電話給你。
dialogue.pinyin: Shì a, nǐ gāngcái zài nǎlǐ? Wǒ dǎ diànhuà gěi nǐ.
dialogue.gloss: Yeah! Where were you just now? I called you.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ zài bàngōngshì, tài máng le.
dialogue.gloss: I was in the office, too busy.

dialogue.speaker: 小安
dialogue.hanzi: 晚上有表演，你要不要一起去看？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǎnshàng yǒu biǎoyǎn, nǐ yào bú yào yìqǐ qù kàn?
dialogue.gloss: There's a show tonight; do you want to go watch it together?

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 好啊！辦公室六點關門，我們幾點見？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo a! Bàngōngshì liù diǎn guān mén, wǒmen jǐ diǎn jiàn?
dialogue.gloss: Sure! The office closes at six; what time shall we meet?

dialogue.speaker: 小安
dialogue.hanzi: 那我們六點半在捷運站見。
dialogue.pinyin: Nà wǒmen liù diǎn bàn zài jiéyùn zhàn jiàn.
dialogue.gloss: Then let's meet at the MRT station at six thirty.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gāngcái zài bàngōngshì dǎ diànhuà.
sentences.gloss: I made a phone call in the office just now.
Please close the door, thank you.
My little sister is very good at drawing.

sentences.pinyin: Tā xué Zhōngwén xué le hěn jiǔ le.
sentences.gloss: He has been studying Chinese for a long time.

example.hanzi: 這家店的環境很好，也很安靜。
example.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de huánjìng hěn hǎo, yě hěn ānjìng.
example.gloss: This shop's environment is nice and quiet.

vocab.gloss: to be concerned about; to care about

example.hanzi: 謝謝你的關心，我已經好多了。
example.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ de guānxīn, wǒ yǐjīng hǎo duō le.
example.gloss: Thanks for your concern, I'm much better already.

vocab.gloss: to pray for; to wish (sb bon voyage, happy birthday etc); person who invokes the spirits during sacrificial ceremonies
to pile on top of one another; layer; stratum; floor (of a building); story

example.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng zài dì-èr céng lóu.
example.gloss: That restaurant is on the second floor.

example.hanzi: 我昨天跑步，今天腿很痛。
example.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān pǎobù, jīntiān tuǐ hěn tòng.
example.gloss: I went running yesterday, and today my legs hurt.

vocab.gloss: team; class; grade; (military) squad; work shift

example.pinyin: Wǒmen bān yǒu èrshí ge xuéshēng.
example.gloss: There are twenty students in our class.

grammar.title: 用「祝」說祝福的話
grammar.explanation: 「祝」用在句子開頭，後面先說對象（你、你們、大家），再說希望發生的好事，像「生日快樂」、「身體健康」。這是台灣人在生日、過年或朋友出門旅行時常說的話。

dialogue.speaker: 小張
dialogue.hanzi: 小明，你的新家在哪裡？環境好嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng: Xiǎo Míng, nǐ de xīn jiā zài nǎlǐ? Huánjìng hǎo ma?
dialogue.gloss: Xiao Ming, where's your new place? Is the environment good?

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 在第十二層，很安靜，住起來很舒服。
dialogue.pinyin: Zài dì-shí'èr céng, hěn ānjìng, zhù qǐlái hěn shūfú.
dialogue.gloss: On the twelfth floor; it's quiet and comfortable to live in.

dialogue.speaker: 小張
dialogue.hanzi: 那你怎麼上班？走路去嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nà nǐ zěnme shàngbān? Zǒulù qù ma?
dialogue.gloss: Then how do you get to work? Do you walk?

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 我搭捷運，很快。可是昨天走太多路，腿有點痛。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ dā jiéyùn, hěn kuài. Kěshì zuótiān zǒu tài duō lù, tuǐ yǒudiǎn tòng.
dialogue.gloss: I take the MRT, it's fast. But I walked too much yesterday, so my legs hurt a bit.

dialogue.speaker: 小張
dialogue.hanzi: 你要多休息喔。對了，明天是你生日，祝你生日快樂！
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ yào duō xiūxí ō. Duì le, míngtiān shì nǐ shēngrì, zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
dialogue.gloss: You should rest more. Oh right, tomorrow is your birthday — happy birthday!

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 謝謝你的關心！明天一起去吃飯吧。
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ de guānxīn! Míngtiān yìqǐ qù chīfàn ba.
dialogue.gloss: Thanks for caring! Let's go eat together tomorrow.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de huánjìng hěn ānjìng.
sentences.gloss: This shop's environment is very quiet.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de tuǐ yǒu yìdiǎn tòng.
Wǒmen bān yǒu èrshí ge xuéshēng.
